title: HELIX: HEterogeneous LLM Inference with FleXible and Fine-Grained Partitioning
abstract: arXiv:2611.06513v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM inference is inherently heterogeneous, with performance bottlenecks shifting throughout inference phases down to individual operators. This has motivated heterogeneous serving systems that disaggregate execution across specialized accelerators, typically through fixed partitions such as prefill/decode or attention/FFN. However, these approaches commit to a partitioning strategy in advance, limiting their ability to adapt to different workloads and model architectures while forcing emerging accelerators into predefined roles. We present HELIX, a vLLM-based software stack that discovers, compiles and dispatches workload-aware partitions across heterogeneous accelerators at the operator granularity. At engine initialization, HELIX automatically determines hardware-specific operator placements that minimize execution latency, accounting for profiled execution costs, communication overheads, device capabilities, and memory constraints. translated_title: HELIX：具有灵活且细粒度分区的异构大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理本质上是异构的，其性能瓶颈会在推理的各个阶段乃至单个算子层面发生转移。这促使人们开发异构服务系统，将执行过程分散部署到专用加速器上，通常采用固定分区方式，例如预填充/解码（prefill/decode）或注意力/前馈网络（attention/FFN）。然而，这些方法预先确定分区策略，限制了其适应不同工作负载和模型架构的能力，并迫使新兴加速器只能承担预定义的角色。我们提出了HELIX，一个基于vLLM的软件栈，它能够在算子粒度上发现、编译并调度工作负载感知的分区，部署于异构加速器之间。在引擎初始化时，HELIX会自动确定针对特定硬件的算子放置方案以最小化执行延迟，同时综合考虑剖析得到的执行成本、通信开销、设备能力以及内存约束。它
tldr: HELIX是一个基于vLLM的异构LLM推理软件栈，能够在算子粒度上自动发现、编译并调度工作负载感知的分区，以最小化异构加速器上的执行延迟。
en_tdlr: HELIX is a vLLM-based software stack that automatically discovers, compiles, and dispatches workload-aware partitions at operator granularity across heterogeneous accelerators to minimize execution latency.
